[Iteration 0] Generated requirements specification:
- 10 User Needs
- 7 Functional Requirements
- 6 Non-Functional Requirements
- 10 User Stories

user_needs.user_need: I need to access football news, live scores, and team/player information quickly and reliably so that I can stay informed about my favorite teams and competitions.
user_needs.user_journey: User opens the app to check latest news, scores, and information about their favorite teams and competitions.

user_needs.user_need: I want to personalize my app experience by selecting favorite teams and sports channels so that I only see relevant news and live updates.
user_needs.user_journey: User configures preferences during onboarding or in settings to follow specific teams and channels.

user_needs.user_need: I want to receive real-time notifications about news and live results for my favorite teams so that I never miss important updates.
user_needs.user_journey: User enables notifications and receives push alerts for selected teams and events.

user_needs.user_need: I want to watch live streams of matches when available and permitted in my country so that I can follow games directly from the app.
user_needs.user_journey: User accesses live stream links for matches, with access controlled by transmission rights and location.

user_needs.user_need: I want to share news and match reports via social media so that I can engage with my friends and community.
user_needs.user_journey: User reads a news article or match report and shares it directly to social media platforms.

user_needs.user_need: I need the app to load and be ready to use within two seconds so that I can access information without delay.
user_needs.user_journey: User launches the app and expects immediate access to main features.

user_needs.user_need: I need the app to function reliably even with limited network coverage or temporary offline conditions so that I can continue using the app without interruption.
user_needs.user_journey: User accesses the app in areas with poor or no network and expects basic functionality.

user_needs.user_need: I need my personal data to be protected and processed in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy is ensured.
user_needs.user_journey: User registers, logs in, and uses the app, expecting their data to be handled securely and lawfully.

user_needs.user_need: I need the app to support up to 100,000 simultaneous users without performance loss so that I can use the app even during peak times.
user_needs.user_journey: User accesses the app during high-traffic events (e.g., match days) and expects normal performance.

user_needs.user_need: I want the registration and login process to be simple and quick so that I can start using the app immediately.
user_needs.user_journey: User downloads the app and completes registration/login with minimal steps.

functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall allow users to view current football news, live scores, and detailed team/player information for all national and international leagues and competitions.
The system shall enable users to select and follow their favorite teams and preferred sports channels.
The system shall provide a live ticker module that retrieves and displays live match data in real time via an external API.
The system shall allow users to enable notifications for news and live results related to their selected favorite teams.
The system shall integrate live stream links for matches, displaying them only when the broadcast has begun and transmission rights are fulfilled for the user's country.
The system shall allow users to share news articles and match reports directly to social media platforms.
The system shall provide a registration and login process that can be completed directly at app startup with minimal steps.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall fully load and be ready for user interaction within two seconds of app launch on supported Android and iOS devices.
The system shall maintain core functionality and allow access to previously loaded data when the device is offline or has limited network connectivity.
The system shall support at least 100,000 simultaneous users without degradation of performance during peak usage periods.
The system shall process and store all personal user data in compliance with GDPR requirements.
The system shall undergo thorough testing and support processes prior to release to detect and resolve malfunctions.
The system shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality.

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to view current news, live scores, and team/player information so that I can stay informed about my favorite teams and competitions.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: View news and scores for favorite teams
acceptance_criteria.given: Given I am logged into the app and have selected my favorite teams
acceptance_criteria.when: When I open the home screen
acceptance_criteria.then: Then I see the latest news, live scores, and team/player information for my selected teams

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to select my favorite teams and sports channels so that I only see relevant news and updates.

acceptance_criteria.given: Given I am on the preferences or onboarding screen
acceptance_criteria.when: When I select teams and channels and save my preferences
acceptance_criteria.then: Then the app displays news and updates only for my selected teams and channels

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to receive real-time notifications about news and live results for my favorite teams so that I never miss important updates.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Receive push notifications for favorite teams
acceptance_criteria.given: Given I have enabled notifications for my favorite teams
acceptance_criteria.when: When a relevant news item or live result is available
acceptance_criteria.then: Then I receive a push notification on my device

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to watch live streams of matches when available and permitted in my country so that I can follow games directly from the app.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Access live stream link when permitted
acceptance_criteria.given: Given a live broadcast has begun and transmission rights are fulfilled for my country
acceptance_criteria.when: When I open the match details screen
acceptance_criteria.then: Then I see and can access the live stream link

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Live stream not available due to rights
acceptance_criteria.given: Given transmission rights are not fulfilled for my country
acceptance_criteria.when: When I open the match details screen
acceptance_criteria.then: Then the live stream link is not displayed

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to share news and match reports via social media so that I can engage with my friends and community.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Share news article to social media
acceptance_criteria.given: Given I am viewing a news article or match report
acceptance_criteria.when: When I tap the share button and select a social media platform
acceptance_criteria.then: Then the article or report is shared to the selected platform

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want the app to load and be ready to use within two seconds so that I can access information without delay.

acceptance_criteria.given: Given I launch the app on a supported device
acceptance_criteria.then: Then the main screen is fully loaded and interactive within two seconds

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want the app to function reliably even with limited network coverage or offline so that I can continue using the app.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Offline access to previously loaded data
acceptance_criteria.given: Given I have previously loaded data in the app
acceptance_criteria.when: When my device is offline or has poor connectivity
acceptance_criteria.then: Then I can still access the previously loaded data

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want my personal data to be protected and processed in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy is ensured.

acceptance_criteria.given: Given I have registered and provided personal data
acceptance_criteria.then: Then my data is processed and stored according to GDPR requirements

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want the app to support up to 100,000 simultaneous users without performance loss so that I can use the app during peak times.

acceptance_criteria.given: Given there are up to 100,000 users accessing the app simultaneously
acceptance_criteria.when: When I use the app during peak events
acceptance_criteria.then: Then the app performance remains consistent and responsive

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to complete registration and login quickly at app startup so that I can start using the app immediately.

acceptance_criteria.given: Given I have just installed the app
acceptance_criteria.when: When I open the app for the first time
acceptance_criteria.then: Then I can complete registration and login with minimal steps

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Details of Supported Social Media Platforms
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: The requirement to share news and match reports to social media is stated, but the specific platforms (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp) are not listed.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Clarify which social media platforms must be supported for sharing content.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Offline Functionality Scope
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: It is stated that the app remains usable offline, but it is unclear which features (e.g., news, live scores, team info) are available offline and how data is cached.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Define the minimum set of features and data available to users when offline, and specify caching/refresh logic.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Registration and Login Methods
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: The registration and login process is described as 'uncomplicated,' but it is not specified whether third-party authentication (e.g., Google, Apple, Facebook) is supported.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Clarify if social login or only email/password registration is required.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Notification Preferences Granularity
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: Users can enable notifications for news and live results, but it is not specified if users can customize notification types (e.g., only goals, only news, all events).
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Specify the level of granularity for notification preferences.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Live Stream Provider Integration
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: Live stream links are integrated from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport, but the technical method of integration (deep link, in-app browser, embedded player) is not described.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Clarify the integration method for live stream links and any requirements for user authentication with third-party providers.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: User Feedback and Review Evaluation Process
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: Continuous evaluation of user feedback and app reviews is mentioned, but the process and responsible roles are not defined.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Define how user feedback is collected, evaluated, and actioned, and who is responsible for this process.

supervisor_feedback:
Clarify which social media platforms must be supported for sharing content (see gap: 'Details of Supported Social Media Platforms'). Add this detail to FR-006 and US-005.
Define the minimum set of features and data available to users when offline, and specify caching/refresh logic (see gap: 'Offline Functionality Scope'). Update NFR-002 and US-007 accordingly.
Specify whether third-party authentication (e.g., Google, Apple, Facebook) is required for registration/login, or if only email/password is supported (see gap: 'Registration and Login Methods'). Update FR-007 and US-010.
Specify the level of granularity for notification preferences (e.g., only goals, only news, all events) (see gap: 'Notification Preferences Granularity'). Update FR-004 and US-003.
Clarify the integration method for live stream links (deep link, in-app browser, embedded player) and any requirements for user authentication with third-party providers (see gap: 'Live Stream Provider Integration'). Update FR-005 and US-004.
Define how user feedback is collected, evaluated, and actioned, and who is responsible for this process (see gap: 'User Feedback and Review Evaluation Process'). Update NFR-006 and US-009.
input: We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices. It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting. With our app, we want to offer football fans a central platform where they can stay comprehensively informed at all times. To achieve this, users can display current football news of their favorite teams and also select preferred sports channels individually. In addition to the news, users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker. Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international. Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time. Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun. Of course, it is ensured that compliance with transmission rights is maintained. Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country. The LiveFootball app should also give users the option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time. To implement this function, the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time. The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly. The user interface is a key component of the app and connects various modules that are displayed together and managed via the interface. The live ticker module communicates directly via the interface with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data. The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server. The server is located outside the app and provides the data dynamically so that the live ticker module can access it flexibly. In addition to the live ticker module, the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface. Furthermore, the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated. All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates. Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup. Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams. In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app. We are aware that many mobile apps have to operate under difficult conditions. Therefore, the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage. The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection. On match days with a particularly high number of accesses, our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss. To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early. In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality. Data protection is our highest priority. All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR.
